predecessors.name: Umayyad Caliphate
predecessors.text: Cyprus, which Arab Muslims 'invaded ... in the 650s and conquered'

successors.name: Byzantine Empire
successors.text: the island, conquered in 965 by Niketas Chalkoutzes for the Byzantine Empire and made a theme

ledger.x: 688: the Umayyad caliph and the Byzantine emperor agree to share Cyprus.
965: Niketas Chalkoutzes conquers Cyprus for Byzantium.

wars.name: Byzantine conquest of Cyprus
wars.outcome: The Byzantine navy conquered the island in 965 and ended the three-century condominium; Cyprus became a Byzantine theme.

certainty.note: A shared island: the pages give no line of division, taxes or garrisons; the coast is the border.
